a: अवचार — a. Going or moving down in or upon. --रः A place of descent, road; field of action.

v: tri॰ ava + cara--Ric--lyuw । 1 pracAraResuSrutokte 2 kzArapAkaviDO ca “viSezakriyAvacAraRAcca” “kzetrARi grahaRaM jAtIH pozaRaM sAvacAraRam” SukradozakzayakaraM yaTAsvamavacAraRam” suSrutaH ।
m: अव-चारण mfn. running, ib.
अव-चारण n. (in med.) application, Suśr.
a: अवचारण — a. Moving, going. --णं 1 Employing, application, mode of proceeding. --2 A kind of saline preparation (क्षारपाकविधि).

m: अव-चारित mfn. (in med.) applied, Suśr.

a: अवचार्य — a. To be cast down, to be given, to be put on or applied.

v: pu॰ ava + ci “hastAdAne cerasteye” pA॰ acovADako Gaj । hastena puzpaPalAdyAdAne । “aviratakusumAvacAyaKedA” mAGaH । ava + ci--Ramul avacAyam । aBIkzRamavacityetyarTe avya॰ ।
a: अवचायः — [अव-चि-घञ्] Gathering flowers (with the hands); अविरतकुसुमावचायखेदात् Śi. 7. 71.

m: अव-चायिन् mfn. gathering, Kathās.
a: अवचायिन् — a. Gathering, picking off.

m: अव-च्छादन n. covering, Drāhy. (Sch.).
अव-च्छात mfn. skinned, L.
reaped, KātyŚr.
emaciated (as by abstinence), Gaut.
अव-च्छद् (√ छद्), -च्छादयति (ind.p. -च्छाद्य) to cover over, overspread, KātyŚr. &c.; to cover, conceal, Kād.; Kathās.; to obscure, leave in darkness, BhP.
a: अवच्छद् — {c10c} P. 1 To cover over, overspread. --2 To conceal, obscure, leave in darkness.

m: अव-च्छद m. a cover, R. iii, 56, 48.
a: अवच्छ(च्छा)दः — A cover, covering; कांचनावच्छादान् (खरान्) Rām.

m: अव-च्छन्न mfn. covered over, overspread, covered with (instr.), BhP.; Kād. &c.
filled (as with anger), MBh. xii, 5835.
अवच्छेदावच्छेद m. removing distinctions, generalising, L.

s: puM, (ava + Cid + BAve GaY .) paricCedaH । ekadeSaH । viSezaRatvaM ॥ (“SabdArTasyAnavacCede viSezasmftihetavaH” । iti sAhityadarpaRam .)
v: pu॰ ava + Cida--BAve GaY । 1 Cedane 2 sImAkaraRe 3 viSezakaraRe 4 avaDAraRe “SabdArTAnAmavacCede viSezasmfti hetavaH” vAkya pa॰ 5 iyattAkaraRe 6 vyAptO ca । avacCidyate 'nena karaRe GaY । iyattAkaraRasADane 7 ekadeSe avayavAdO । yaH kaScit padArTaH kasmiMcidADAre ekadeSe tizWati tatrEva pradeSAntare cenna tizWatIti sa avyApyavfttiH tasyAvyApyavfttitAyA nirUpako'vayavAdiH । yaTA vfkze agradeSe kapisaMvogaH mUladeSe tadaBAvaH ataH kapisaMyogaH avyApyavfttiH tAdfSAvyApyavfttitAyA niyAmakaSca mUlAdipradeSaH tatrAvacCedaSabdenABiDIyate । tAdfSAvacCedaSca dviviDaH deSaH kAlaSca । tatra deSasattve kAla viSeze tadaBAvAt kAlaeva tatrAvyApyavfttitAyAniyAmakaH । yaTA Atmani jAgradAdO jYAnaM suzuptO tadaBAvaH । deSarUpastUktaH । avacCedAvacCedena sADyasidDvO sAmAnADiraRyasidDiH pratibanDikA iti SiromaRiH । avacCedAH yAvantaH sADyasidDO pradeSAstAvatAmevAvacCedena sADyasambanDavyApakatveneti tadarTaH ।
m: अव-च्छेद m. anything cut off (as from clothes), ĀśvŚr.
part, portion (as of a recitation), ib.
separation, discrimination
(in logic) distinction, particularising, determining
a predicate (the property of a thing by which it is distinguished from everything else).
a: अवच्छेदः — 1 A part, portion, ( अवयव). --2 Boundary, limit. --3 Separation. --4 Distinction, distinguishing, particularization (as by attributes). --5 Determination, decision, settlement; शब्दार्थस्यानवच्छेदे विशेषस्मृतिहेतवः Vāk. P. --6 That property of a thing which distinguishes it from every thing else, a characteristic property. --7 Bounding, defining. --8 Pervading (व्याप्तिः). ˚अवच्छेदः generalizing, removing distinctions.

s: tri, (avacCinatti, ava + Cid + Rvul .) nyAyamate avyApyavfttyaDikaraRasambanDEkadeSaH । itaravyAvarttakaH । viSezaRaM । avacCidyate'neneti yaTA । avyApyavftteravacCedakatvamapi svarUpasambanDaviSezaH tadASrayAvacCedakaH । itinyAyaSAstraM ॥
v: tri॰ avacCinnati ava + Cida--Rvul । 1 Cedake 2 iyattAkArake 3 sImAkArake 4 avaDArake 5 avyApyavftti tAnirUpake ca । avacCinnaSabde vivftiH । “pratiyogitAvacCedakAvacCinnamiti” cintAmaRiH । abacCedakatvaM ca avadake iva tadavacCedake'pi svIkriyate yaTA vahnimAn parvvata iti budDO vahnyaBAvavAn parbData iti niScayaHpratibanDakaH tatra pratibanDakatAvacCedakaM niScayatvamiva tattadvizayatA'pi tatrAvacCedikA taTA ca bahnitvAvacCinnaprakAratAnirUpitaparvvatatvAvacCinnaviSezyatASAlijYAnatvAvacCinnaM prati vahnitvAvacCinnaprakAratAnirUpitABAvatvAvacCiviSezyatAsamAnADikaraRaprakAratAnirUpitaparvatatvAvacCinnaviSezyatASAliniScayatvena pratibanDakatve niScayatvasyeva tattadvizayatAyA api tatpratibanDakatAvacCedakatvaM taTA tAdfSajYAnatvasyeva tattadvizayatAyA api pratibaDyatAvacCedakatvam । iyAMstuBedaH anulleKyamAnajAteH svarUpato'vacCedakatvaM na tadavacCedakatAyA avacCedakamasti tena GawavadBUtalamiti budDO GawatvanizWaprakAratAvacCedakatAyA nAnyadavacCedakam taTAca yaTA GawanizWaprakAratAyA avacCedakam Gawatvam evaM GawatvanizWaprakA ratAyAnAnyadavacCedakamatastasya niracCinnAvacCedakatA anulliKyamAnetyukterulliKyamAnajAternasvarUpato'vacCedakatvaM tena GawatvavattvAn deSa ityAdO GawatvaprakAratAyA avacCedakamastIti । atrApyayaMviSezaH DarmmyaMSe BAmamAnaDarmmaH viSezyatAvacCedakaH prakArAMSe BAsamAnaH prakAratAcCedakaevaM sarvvatra । kintu pratiyogyaMSe BAsamAnaDarmmasya na pratiyogitAvacCedakatvamapi tu atiprasaNgAdyanApAdakasyEva Garmasya taTAtvaM yaTA kambugrIvAdimAnnAsti ityAdyaBAvabudDO GawatvasyEva pratiyogitAvacCedakatvam “samBavati laGO Darmme guro tadaBAvAt” dIDityukteH SakyatAvacCedakatvaM vizayatAvacCedakatvavat guruDamasyApi svIkftamAkare ।
m: अव-च्छेदक mfn. distinguishing, particularising, determining
अव-च्छेदक m. ‘that which distinguishes’, a predicate, characteristic, property, L.
a: अवच्छेदक — a. 1 Separating. --2 Determining, deciding, प्रतियोगिकावच्छेदकावच्छिन्नं --3 Bounding, limiting. --4 Pervading. --5 Distinguishing, particularizing. --6 Peculiar, characteristic. --कः 1 That which distinguishes. --2 A predicate, characteristic property. --3 Boundary, limit.

s: klI, (avacCedakasya BAvaH, BAvArTe tva .) svarUpasambanDaviSezaH । yaTA । GawakaYcAvacCedakatvaM svarUpasambanDaviSezaH । ityavacCedakatvaniruktO SiromaRiH ॥ anatiriktavfttitvaM । yaTA । avacCedakatvaYca ihAnatiriktavfttitvaM । tena viSizwasyAsatvepi BramAt pratibanDe'pi na kzatiH । iti sAmAnyaniruktO SiromaRiH ॥ anyUnAnatiriktavfttitvaM । yaTA । nanu tAdfSapratiyogitvAnyUnAnatiriktavfttitvaM vAcyaM । vahnitvaM na Gawavftti tAdfSapratiyogitvAnyUnAnatiriktavftti ataAha tArRatArReti । ityavacCedakatvaniruktO jagadISaH ॥ anatiriktavfttitvarUpAvacCedakatvaM pAriBAzikaM । yaTA । tadavacCinnABAvavadasambadDasvaviSizwasAmAnyakatvaM svaviSizwasambanDinizWABAvapratiyogitAnavacCedakatatkatvaM vA tadanatiriktavfttitvaM vaktavyaM । iti avacCedakatvaniruktO SiromaRiH ॥ avyApyavftteravacCedakatvamapi svarUpasambanDaviSezaH tadASrayAvacCedakaH । taccAvacCedakatvaM iha SiKariRi nitambe hutASano na SiKare ityAdi pratItibalAt kutracidavyApyavfttyaDikaraRadeSaviSezAdidAnIM gozWe gOrnatu gfhe ityAdipratItibalAt kutracit deSavfttitAyAH kAle kutracit kAlavfttitAyA deSe apyasti । iti nyAyaSAstraM ॥

m: अव-च्छेदन n. cutting off, L.
dividing, L.
discriminating, distinguishing, L.
a: अवच्छेदनं — Cutting off, separating; determining, bounding &c.

v: tri॰ ava + Cida--Ryat । 1 CedanArhe 2 avaDAryye viSezaRIye 3 avacCedArhe ca padArTe yaTA daRqatvenAvacCedyA GawAdikAraRatA GawatvenAvacCedyA GawapratiyogitA ।
m: अव-च्छेद्य mfn. to be separated.
अव-च्छिद् (√ छिद्) to refuse any one, Kād. : Pass. अव-च्छिद्यते, to be separated from (abl.), TS.
a: अवच्छिद् — {c7c} U. 1 To cut off, separate, tear in pieces, break asunder. --2 To discriminate, distinguish, characterize. --3 To define, limit, modify (as by time, space &c.,) used in Nyāya; see अवच्छिन्न below. --4 To detach, excerpt. --5 To interrupt.

s: tri, (ava + Cid + kta .) avacCedakatAnirUpakaM । viSizwaM । iti nyAyaBAzA । avacCedASrayaH । yaTA । pratiyogyasamAnADikaraRayatsAmAnADikaraRAtyantABAvapratiyogitAvacCedakAvacCinnaM yanna Bavati tena samaM tasya sAmAnADikaraRyaMvyAptiH । iti sidDAntalakzaRacintAmaRiH ॥ (“jalASaye mahAkASastadavacCinnameva hi । budDyavacCinnacEtanyamekaM pUrRamaTAparam ॥ sABAsabudDeH kartftvamavacCinne vikAriRi” । iti aDyAtmarAmAyaRe .)
v: tri॰ ava + Cida--kta । avacCedaH viSezaRopAGinA viSezakaraRam । upADyAdinA viSezite avacCedakatAnirUpite ca “pratiyogyasamAnADikaraRayatsamAnADikaraRAtyantABAvapratiyogitAcCedakAvacCinnaM yanna BavatIti” cintAmaRiH । avacCedakatA hi svarUpasambanDaviSezaH anatiriktavfttitvaM vA tannirUpitatvamavacCinnatvaM yaTA daRqAdInAM GawakAraRatAvacCedakaM daRqatvAdikaM tasya tadatiriktadeSe'vfttitvAt evaM GawAdInAmatyantABAvapratiyogitAyAH tadatiriktadeSe'vfttitvAt GawatvAdikamavacCedakam ataH pratiyogitAyAM GawAdyavacCinnatvam । parimARAdO ca avacCinnatvamiyattAkaraRam yaTA droRAvacCinnobrIhiH drIRaparimARena kftaparicCedovrIhirityarTaH । sImAkaraRamapyavacCedaH । gfhAvacCinna AkASaH gfhAkASaH karRRaSazkulyavacCinnaM AkASaH SrotramityAdi । evamantaHkaraRAvacCinnaM cEtanyaM jIva iti vedAntinaH ।
m: अव-च्छिन्न mfn. separated, detached, Lāṭy. &c.
(in logic) predicated (i.e. separated from everything else by the properties predicated), distinguished, particularised, Sarvad. &c.
a: अवच्छिन्न — p. p. 1 Cut off. --2 Separated, divided, detached, excerpted. --3 (In Logic) Separated or excluded from all other things by the properties predicated of a thing as peculiar to itself. --4 Bounded, modified, determined; दिक्कालाद्यनवच्छिन्न Bh. 2. 1. --5 Particularized, distinguished, characterized, as by an attributive word.

v: pu॰ avacCinnatayA antaHkaraRAvacCinnatayA jIvasya vAdovyavasTApanam । vedAntimataprasidDe cEtanyasya antaH karaRAvacCidvatayA vyavasTApake mataBede । taTAhi tezAM matadvEDam kecit antaHkaraRe prativimbitaM cEtanyaM jIva iti pratipedire kecicca tadavacCinnaM cEtanyaMjIva iti । tatra nIrUpasya cEtanyasyAntaHkaraRe prativimbAsamBavena prativimbasya ca miTyAtvena jIvasya satyatvAnupapatteH banDamokzayoH sAmAnADikaraRyABAvApatteH prativimbavAdaM dUzayitvA'vacCinnavAdaM samarTayAYcakrire । taTA ca nEyAyikAdInAmekasyApi naBasaH karRRaSazkulyAdiBedena upADikftaM nAnAtvaM na vastukftamevamekasyApi cEtanyasyAntaHkaraRopADiBedenAvacCinnatayA nAnAtvaM tena “tadguRasAratvAt” SA॰ sU॰ “GawasaMvftaAkASe nIyamAne yaTA Gawe । GawonIyeta nAkASastadvaMjjIvonaBopama” ityukteSca jIvasya na svata ihalokaparalokagAmitvamapi tu budDirUpAziBedana taTAvyavahAraH ato na banDamokzavyavasTAnupapattiH yanninnupADO ajYAnADInA saMsArapravfttistasya jIvaBAvAtmakatayA banDaH, yatra ca tannivfttiH na tatra taTA, kintumokzaH । vistarastvAkare ।

m: अव-च्छित mfn. skinned, L.
reaped, ŚBr.
अव-च्छो (√ छो), (ind.p. -च्छाय) to cut off; to skin, ŚBr.

s: klI, (ava + cCura + BAve kta .) mahAhAsyaM । ityamarawIkAyAM BarataH ॥
v: na॰ । ava + Cura--BAve kta । 1 awwahAsesvArTe kan tatrEva । karmmaRi kta । 2 miSrite tri॰ ।
m: अव-च्छुरित or अव-च्छुरितक, n. a horselaugh, L.
a: अवच्छुरित — a. Mixed. --तं A horselaugh.

s: klI, (avacCuritameva, svArTe kan .) mahAhAsyaM । iti SabdaratnAbalI ॥

m: अव-चीर-विचीरक mfn. dilapidation, ib.

s: puM, (avanatA cUqA yasya, vA qasya laH .) DvajAgrabadDADomuKavastraM । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: na॰ avacUqavat vigrahaH । DvajADaHsTe 1 cAmarAdO DvajAdyaNge “divasakaravAraRasyAvacUlacAmarakalApa iva” kAda॰ ।
m: अव-चूल m. = अव-चूड m., Kād.
अव-चूल See अव-चूड, col. 1.
a: अवचूल — = अवचूड q. v.

s: klI, (avacUlamiva ivArTe kan, saMjYAyAM vA kan .) cAmaraM । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
v: na॰ avacUlamiva ivArTe kan saMjYAyAM vA kan । cAmare trikA॰ ।
m: अव-चूलक n. a chowri or brush (formed of a cow's tail, peacock's feathers, &c., for warding off flies), L.
a: अवचूलकः, --कं — A chowri or brush (formed of a cow's tail or peacock's feathers) for fanning off flies.

m: अव-चूडा f. a pendent tuft or garland (an ornament of peacock feathers hanging down), Śiś. iii, 5.

v: pu॰ avanatA cUqAgraM yasya vA qolaH । 1 DvajADobadDe vastre । “picCAvacUqakalanAmivoraH” “picCAvacuqamanumADavaDAma jagmuH” iti ca mAGaH “asyoccUqAvacUqAKyO mUrdDADomuKacUqayoriti” halA॰ ukteH 2 DvajAzomuKANge cAmarAdO ca ।
m: अव-चूड m. the pendent crest or streamer of a standard, Śiś. v, 13
a: अवचूडः --लः — [अवनता चूडा अग्रं यस्य वा डो लः] The pendent cloth on a chariot, an ornament (like a chowri) hanging from the top of a banner; पिच्छावचूडमनुमाधवधाम जग्मुः Śi. 5. 13; दिवसकरवारणस्यावचूलचामरकलापः K. 26, 114, 116; Śi. 20. 46, 12. 18.

m: अव-√ चूर्ण् -चूर्णयति, (ind.p. -चूर्ण्य) to sprinkle or cover with meal, dust, &c., Hariv.; Suśr. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 1, 25, Sch.)
a: अवचूर्ण् — {c10c} P. 1 To sprinkle with meal, dust. --2 To cover, put on or over, overlay; चूर्णैः शनैर्व्रणमुखमवचूर्ण्य Suśr.; भेर्यो दिव्यपुष्पावचूर्णिताः Mb.

v: na॰ suSrutokte 1 vraRarogaBede । “tatra braRasya zazwirupakramA Bavanti” ityupakramya “sarpistElaM rasakriyAvacUrRRana vraRaDUpanam” ityuktvA “tezu kazAyo varttiH kalkaH sarpistElaM rasakriyAvacUrRRanamiti SoDanaropaRAnIti” । ava + cUrRRa--BAve lyuw । 2 pezaRe । cUrRREraDvaMsate avacUrRRa yati ava + cUrRRa + avaDvaMsArTe Ric--BAve lyuw । 3 cUrRRanenAvaDvaMse ।
tri॰ ava + cUrRRa--peze karmmaRi kta । 1 pizwe । avacUrRRayaternAmaDAtoH kta । 2 cUrRRanenAvaDvaste ।

m: अव-चूर्णन n. sprinkling with, Suśr.
a: अवचूर्णनं — 1 Pounding, grinding, reducing to powder. --2 Sprinkling with powder; especially, throwing absorbent powders on wounds. --3 A kind of disease or wound.

s: tri, (ava + cUrRa + karmmaRi kta .) cUrRIkftadravyaM । gu~qA karA iti BAzA । tatparyyAyaH । avaDvastaH 2 apaDvastaH 3 । ityamaraH tawwIkA ca ॥
m: अव-चूर्णित mfn. sprinkled with powder, &c., MBh. &c.
(with flowers), MBh. ii, 813.
a: अवचूर्णित — a. 1 Pounded coarsely; त्रिजातावचूर्णितेन mixed with Dk. 133. --2 Ground, crushed, reduced to powder.

k.v: अवरीणो धिक्कृतश्चाप्यवध्वस्तोऽवचूर्णितः। अनायासकृतं फाण्टं स्वनितं ध्वनितं समे॥

m: अव-चूरि or अव-चूरिका, f. a gloss, short commentary.
अवच ‘lower’, in उच्चावच, q.v.
a: अवच — a. Lower.
अवचंद्रमसं — The looking down of the moon (Ved.).

m: अव-√ चक्ष् Ā. -चष्टे (impf. -चक्षत; aor. 1. sg. -अचचक्षम्, 2. sg. -चक्षि; Ved. Inf. -चक्षे) to look down upon, RV.; to perceive, RV. iv, 58, 5 (Inf. in Pass. sense: ‘to be seen by’), & v, 30, 2.
a: अवचक्ष् — {c2c} A. 1 To look down upon (Ved.). --2 To perceive, observe.

v: tri॰ ava + cakza--lyu । ninditAKyAnakarttari “kutsABIkzRAyorarTe etasya tiNaHparatve anudAttatvam ।
a: अवचक्षण — a. One telling a censured tale. --णं Looking down upon.

m: अव-चक्षणम् ind. (g. गोतादि, q.v.)

v: tri॰ vaktumanarhaH vaca--arhArTe anIyar na॰ ta॰ । 1 vaktumanarhe aSlIlAdO Sabde “vAdezvacanIyezu tadeva dviguRaM Bavet” sanuH 1 vacanIyaM nindyam na॰ ta॰ । 2 nindyaBinne tri॰ ।
m: अ-वचनीय mfn. not to be spoken, improper, Mn. viii, 269.
a: अवचनीय — a. 1 Not to be spoken or uttered, obscene or indecent (language); वादेष्ववचनीयेषु तदेव द्विगुणं भवेत् Ms. 8. 269. --2 Not censurable, not blamable, free from censure; लोकैरवचनीया भवति Mk. 2; ˚ता; impropriety of speech, freedom from censure; सर्वथा व्यवहर्तव्ये कुतो ह्यवचनीयता U. 1. 5.

m: अ-वचनीय—ता, f. or अ-वचनीय—त्व, n. impropriety of speech.

v: ma॰ na vacanaM kutsAyAM na॰ ta॰ 1 nindAyAm । aBAve na॰ ta॰ । 2 kaTanABAve “prakftOcAvacanAt” kAtyA॰ 20, 7, 21, “avacane'gnizwomaH” । kAtyA॰ 22, 1, 2 । na॰ ba॰ । 3 vacanaSUnye tri॰ “SakuntalA sADvamAdavacanA tizWati” । Saku॰ ।
m: अ-वचन n. absence of a special assertion, KātyŚr. &c.
अ-वचन mfn. not expressing anything, Jaim.
not speaking, silent, Śak.
a: अवचन — a. [न. ब.] Not speaking, silent, speechless; शकुंतला साध्वसादवचना तिष्ठति Ś. 1. --नं [अभावे न. त.] 1 Absence of assertion, silence, taciturnity; अवचनेऽग्निष्टोमः Kāty. --2 Censure, blame, reproof; ˚कर a. not doing what one is bid, disobedient.

m: अ-वचन—कर mfn. not doing what one is bid or advised.
अव-चन्द्रमस n. disappearance of the moon, ŚBr.
अव-√ चर् (3. pl. -चरन्ति) to come down from (abl.), RV. x, 59, 9 : Caus. (Pot. -चारयेत्; ind.p. -चर्य) to apply (in med.), Suśr.
a: अवचर् — {c1c} U. 1 To move or come down. --2 To go down towards. --Caus. 1 To cause to move or descend upon. --2 To employ, use, apply; लेपान्, शस्त्रं, कषायं &c.

m: अव-चर m. the dominion or sphere or department of (in comp. See कामावचर, ध्यानाव्˚, &c.), Buddh. (cf. तालावचर and यज्ञावचर.)
अव-चरक m. a footman, runner, Divyāv.
अव-चरन्तिका f. (dimin. of pr. p. f. ˚न्ती) stepping down from (abl.), AV. v, 13, 9 (cf. प्रवर् तमनक.)

s: tri, avacanasTaH । kaTAra avADya iti BAzA । na vacaH karotItyarTe vacaHSabdapUrvvakakfDAtoH wapratyayena nizpannaH ॥
m: अ-वचस्-कर mfn. silent, not speaking.
a: अवचस्कर — a. Not speaking, silent, taciturn.

m: अवचत्नुक m. (?), N. of a country, AitBr.

v: pu॰ ava + ci--ac । puzpaPalAdyAdAne । “tataH praviSataH kusumAvacayamaBinayantyO saKyO” Saku॰ ।
m: अव-चय m. gathering (as flowers, fruits, &c.), Śak. &c.
a: अवचयः — Gathering (such as flowers, fruits &c.); ततः प्रविशतः कुसुमावचयमभिनयंत्यौ सख्यौ Ś. 4.

m: अव-√ चृत् (Pot. -चृतेत्) to let loose, TS.

1. अव-√ 1. चि (p. -चिन्वत्, MBh. iii, 13151; ind.p. -चित्य; Inf. -चेतुम्, Kathās.) to gather, collect (as fruits from a tree, वृक्षम् फलानि [double acc.] Pāṇ. i, 4, 51., Kāś.); (p. f. -चिन्वती), to draw back or open one's garment, RV. iii, 61, 4.
2. अव-√ 2. चि (3. pl. -चिन्वन्ति) to examine, MBh. iii, 10676 seq.
a: अवचि — {c3c} P. 1 To worship, honour, respect. --2 ({c5c} U.) To gather, pick up, pluck (with two acc.); गता स्यादवचिन्वाना कुसुमान्याश्रमद्रुमान् Bk. 6. 10; वृक्षमवचिनोति फलानि Sk. --3 To take off. --4 To let down behind, to open (one's cloak).

m: अव-चिचीषा f. (Desid.) a desire to gather, Śiś. vi, 10.
अव-चित mfn. gathered.
a: अवचित — p. p. 1 Gathered. --2 Filled, inhabited.
